sections.title: Roof repair contractor serving Mission
paras: Edel Roofing is based in Edinburg, about 25 minutes from Mission, and has been repairing roofs across Hidalgo County since 2003. A leak or a damaged section usually does not mean a full replacement. Most of the time it is a specific, findable problem, a cracked flashing, a section of missing shingles, a failed vent boot, and it can be fixed in a single visit.

We get repair calls from the older homes near Conway Avenue and downtown Mission, where roofs from the 1970s and 80s are on their second or third repair, and from the newer subdivisions out toward Sharyland, where storm damage is the more common cause. Either way, we inspect first and tell you honestly whether it is a repair or something bigger.
A repair call is not an excuse to upsell a replacement. If a repair is the right fix, that is what we recommend and what we do.

cards.title: Leak Repair
cards.body: Interior water stains, active drips, or damp insulation. We trace the leak to its actual entry point, which is often several feet from where the water shows up inside, and repair it there.

cards.title: Storm & Hail Damage Repair
cards.body: Missing or lifted shingles, granule loss, and impact damage from Hidalgo County storms. We document what we find in writing, which is useful if you are filing an insurance claim.

cards.title: Flashing Repair
cards.body: Flashing around chimneys, vents, and roof valleys is one of the most common leak sources on Mission homes. We reseal or replace failed flashing so water sheds the way it is supposed to.

cards.title: Shingle Replacement (Sections)
cards.body: Cracked, curling, or wind-torn shingles replaced in the affected area, matched as closely as possible to your existing roof.

cards.title: Skylight & Vent Repair
cards.body: Failed skylight seals and roof vent boots are a common, specific leak source. We repair or reseal them without disturbing the rest of the roof.

cards.title: Post-Storm Inspections
cards.body: A full walk of the roof after a hailstorm or high-wind event, with a written report on what needs repair now and what to keep an eye on.

sections.title: What causes most roof repairs in Mission
paras: Mission's heat and UV exposure wear down shingles faster than in cooler climates, shingles that look fine from the ground can already be brittle underneath. That is why a lot of our repair calls near Conway Avenue and downtown start with a homeowner noticing a small ceiling stain that turns out to be a flashing or vent issue that has been dripping slowly for a while.

Out in Sharyland and the newer subdivisions west and north of town, storm damage is the more common trigger, a hail event knocks loose a section of shingles or dents the roof enough to compromise the surface, and the homeowner needs both a repair and documentation for their insurance company.
Either way, the fix starts with an honest inspection. We tell you what we actually see, not what generates the biggest invoice.

faqs.q: What is a fair price for a roof repair in Mission?
faqs.a: Most repairs run a few hundred dollars up to around $1,500, depending on what is wrong and how much of the roof is affected. A fair price is one backed by a written estimate after an actual inspection, not a phone-quote guess. We give you that estimate before any work starts.

faqs.q: What is the average cost to repair a roof in Texas?
faqs.a: Statewide, small repairs like flashing or a section of shingles typically fall between $300 and $1,500. Larger repairs involving decking or a bigger damaged area can run higher. The Valley's heat adds a variable other parts of the state do not deal with as much, UV exposure ages shingles faster, so a repair that looks minor can be sitting on brittle material underneath.

faqs.q: What is the 25% rule for roofing?
faqs.a: It is a code-driven guideline some jurisdictions and insurers apply: if more than 25% of a roof section needs replacing, the whole section (sometimes the whole roof) has to be brought up to current code rather than patched. It matters most on older Mission homes where a "small" repair area can trip that threshold once we actually get up there and measure it.

faqs.q: Will insurance cover a 20-year-old roof in Texas?
faqs.a: It depends on the policy and the cause of damage. Wear-and-tear from age is usually not covered, but a specific event, hail, wind, a storm, often is, even on an older roof. We inspect and document what we find so you have something concrete to bring to your insurance company; we are not a public adjuster, but we can tell you honestly whether what we see looks like an insurable event or ordinary aging.

faqs.q: How do I get a roof repair estimate in Mission?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. We will schedule a time to look at the roof and give you a written estimate. Estimates are free with no obligation.
